raw_text: You must follow the additional conventions below, in addition to the built-in functions. `.rulesync/` is the source of truth. Author changes there first. Regenerate generated targets; do not hand-edit generated target directories to patch a platform quirk. Keep frontmatter strictly RuleSync-compliant. Keep commands deterministic, keep hooks advisory. Use `rulesync generate --check`, then `rulesync generate` when intentional. **Verify target configurations** using `.rulesync/verification/` before committing changes. Use RuleSync commands directly instead of manually reproducing catalog, prompt, incident, or graph logic from source.
